name: Atomic Color Averaging in Voxelization
definition: A method to average fragment colors in a voxel texture using integer atomic operations because floating-point atomics are not available by default for RGB textures.
summary: Atomic Color Averaging is a GPU method that resolves concurrent write race conditions during voxelization by incrementally computing per-voxel color averages using integer atomic compare-and-swap operations within a single packed integer.
